protocol.meaning: Both remaining author length5 condition2 repetitions selected before acquisition. Same nominal setup/condition is author association, not proof of unchanged physical damping. Original three training courses/model choices/settings unchanged. No replacement/tuning/receiving law selection. First receiving result retained separately and now consumed.
protocol.primary: Mean suffix position RMSE over both new repetitions: selected empirical offset versus pooledzero using fixed1s prefix estimator. Retain every course, all3models and observed-start outcomes, allrefusals. No selection by observed errors.
protocol.preprocessing: Original5–25s rows and supplied rate, no smoothing, resampling or recentering. Prefix5–6s estimates starts only, suffix6–25s scores.

metrics.meaning: No training metrics on transferred coefficients

transfer.basis: Conditional unchanged angular damping from new small-baffle length3 training only; no air-only damping reuse
transfer.meaning: Same compact weak operator on original training positions, shared empirical −A/(L+delta) sine coefficient, independent course damping. Supplied starts/rates never fit this relation. Window residual is not forward prediction error, physical geometry calibration or identification. Every offered relation retained; no receiving input.
